functions.name: IsListItemSelected
functions.docs: Returns true if the item represented by this entry is currently selected in the owning list view.

functions.name: IsListItemExpanded
functions.docs: Returns true if the item represented by this entry is currently expanded and showing its children. Tree view entries only.

functions.name: GetOwningListView
functions.docs: Returns the list view that contains this entry.

functions.name: BP_OnEntryReleased
functions.docs: Called when this entry is released from the owning table and no longer represents any list item
